description: Shared cases for the Space design profile. The CLI test (space-design-rules.test.js) and the server test (test_space_design_check.py) both run them, so the JS validator and its Python port stay in step. Each case proves one rule fires on its bad source and not on its good one; each clean source must pass the whole Space profile with no finding at all. icon_cases and icon_clean do the same for the unknown icon check (icons in the rules file): each bad source names its unknown icons by line, each good and clean source has none.
